name: Idempotency-Key
description: Client-chosen key that makes a non-idempotent request retry-safe, following draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header. A committed response is stored for 24 hours and replayed for the same principal, operation, key and payload. Missing key returns 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, a key longer than 255 characters returns 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID, the same key with a different payload returns 422, and the same key while the first request is still in flight returns 409. Failed (rolled-back) requests do not consume the key.
